scope: Randomized variants of the item and enchant effects that needed shared mechanics: Bonereaver's Edge (a stacking armor penetration aura), Thunderfury (Cyclone in the attack speed category, and the nature resistance), the struck, melee, ranged and spell damage procs of client rows, the struck stat and heal procs, the damage shields, Force Reactive Disk, Freezing Band, Darkmoon Cards, the on-use stat items, Jom Gabbar, the idols, librams and totems of another class, Painwalker Buckler under a Goblin Sapper Charge, the on-use damage items and Fiery Blaze against several targets, each in the slot of its type in a production request of up to nine classes, plus the 13 accepted fixtures of the stacking auras, Thunderfury and the shared poison dots. 739 variants of 394 requests at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust.
generator: python3 tools/item_effect_sweep.py variants --output <scratch>, which draws the variants of tools/sweep.py (seed 20261009 plus the row's position, 200 iterations, melee range for a build that stands in melee, the races of the class), then python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <out> <scratch>/*.json

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Jom Gabbar on an Enhancement Shaman and a Protection Warrior is left out: the exporter numbers stat aura combinations in at most 12 bits and the build needs more.
